name: World Class Rugby: Five Nations Edition
summary: World Class Rugby: Five Nations Edition is an updated version of the original World Class Rugby, featuring remade AI and simplified controls. The game centers on the Five Nations championship, where five European national teams (England, France, Ireland, Scotland, and Wales) compete for the trophy. The original World Cup mode from the previous game remains available alongside the new championship mode.
